allowed_candidates.purpose: Keep local secrets and transient files out of the public shared-knowledge repository.
Keep the index namespace visible before generated indexes exist.
Keep the per-user namespace visible before team entries exist.
Keep the current RedCap user namespace visible before Norven publishes append-only entries.

notes: This binding only covers the minimal public template surface plus explicit per-user namespace placeholders.
shared-knowledge/ is the RedCap-internal template source and intentionally has no .git directory.
../redcap-arsenal is the preferred durable local public-library worktree for this installation.
Historical reports, lessons, identity files, runtime evidence, and host entry files are intentionally out of scope unless RedCap Forge produces a reviewed, deduplicated, safe public entry candidate.
After any legitimate template push, update last_verified.remote_head and checked_at_utc by rerunning the live check; head drift is intentional fail-closed behavior.
